question: Identify the top 2 leagues where lightweight players (weight < 160) participated as home team members and whose teams scored the highest total goals during the 2014/2015 season. Return the league names.

prediction.sql:
SELECT L."XCL_005"
FROM League AS L
INNER JOIN Match AS M ON L."XCL_003" = M."XCL_008"
WHERE M."XCL_009" = '2014/2015'
  AND M."XCL_013" IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT M2."XCL_013"
    FROM Match AS M2
    INNER JOIN Player AS P ON M2."XCL_061" = P."XCL_122"
    WHERE P."XCL_127" < 160
  )
GROUP BY L."XCL_005"
ORDER BY SUM(M."XCL_015") DESC
LIMIT 2
